name: disclosegate
description: A pre-push guard against publishing internal detail: work email addresses in commit metadata and trailers, private host, service and client names, home-directory paths and file URLs — checked before the push, because a commit on a forge stays reachable by SHA.

scripts.backlog: node scripts/backlog.mjs lint && node scripts/backlog.mjs check

author: Allan Nava (https://github.com/Allan-Nava)
